pages.title: A Step out of Trouble
pages.text: Upgrade a Netherite armor piece with Cursium and successfully use its vision, dodge or backstep.

pages.title: A Step out of Trouble
pages.text: Follow Cursium upgrading and use movement or vision without overriding death rules.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain the template and ingot normally. Helmet reveals entities through walls, leggings can dodge, and boots reduce falls and backstep. Chestplate has native recovery followed by a blocking debuff: actual death still eliminates a hosted-fight participant.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Cursium features belong to individual pieces; chestplate recovery does not override actual death and JEM elimination.
